'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Chris Twiss LS Yavin 4 Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Twiss]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Y4!

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]
* '''Username:''' vader322
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
